meta.name: cyberedge-query-registrations
meta.description: Query normalized ICP registration and organization relationship intelligence for exact domain targets in an explicitly authorized CyberEdge Scope through a configured licensed provider. Use when an AI operator must inspect registration coverage, correlate a domain with an Organization Asset, or report provider-backed relationships without scraping official query pages or exposing personal data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询域名ICP备案与组织关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过授权接口查询域名备案信息和组织关联关系。
copy.tagline_en: Query domain ICP registration and organization relationships
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query domain ICP registration and organization relationships via an authorized API.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询指定域名的 ICP 备案信息和关联的组织机构，并返回备案号、网站名、主体类型、统一社会信用代码等，不泄露个人数据。
howto.when: 当需要检查某个域名的 ICP 备案覆盖情况、将域名关联到组织资产，或报告基于授权供应商的备案关系时触发。

say.text: 请查询 example.com 的 ICP 备案信息。
say.note: Claude 会返回该域名的备案记录。
Claude 会在授权范围内关联域名与组织。

say.text: 报告 example.com 的备案状态。
say.note: Claude 会提供备案号、状态等详情。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can query ICP registration and organization relationship intelligence for specified domains, returning registration number, site name, entity type, unified social credit code, etc., without exposing personal data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an operator needs to inspect ICP registration coverage, correlate a domain with an Organization Asset, or report provider-backed relationships.

say_en.note: Claude links domain to the organization within scope.
